decisions.reason: As a flagship product line with its own website page and public launch, it carries high sunk costs and public commitment, making management reluctant to drop it.
The continuing education institute builds on existing training resources and likely involved moderate investment, so escalation of commitment favors persistence despite limited public visibility.
A minor support tool with little public commitment and limited investment, disappointing results after a year are unlikely to be seen as temporary, so dropping is more likely.
